Gooey Louie Voiceover

Voiceover of the TV Advert for the crazy kids toy from Ideal Toys - Gooey Louie

‹›

Christmas Toys for Kids

As you can tell, I do a lot of kids toys voiceovers for TV. I guess my energetic voice is a great fit with this industry. I also have a popular Santa voiceover that is used every year. I actually recorded this particular Gooey Louie voiceover a few years ago now, but due to it's popularity at Christmas, it's on every year.
As a voice you can't say no to re-licence fees. 😏
There were several new toys launched around this time including Doggie Doo and Pig goes Pop. And if you'd like to hear even more of my kid's toy voiceovers, check out my Pop-up Pirate and Bugs in the Kitchen videos too.

What is Gooey Louie?

This gruesome Gooey Louie Game will have you laughing for hours. Take it in turns to stick your finger up poor Louie's nose and pull out many stretch gooeys, eurgh! Be careful if you pull out the wrong gooey then his eyes will bulge and his brain will explode!
Pull out one of Louie's many stretchy gooeys, it could be short or it could be long! This is such a fun, delightfully gross board game and it was a lot of fun to provide the voiceover for the TV ad!

Need this style?

Are you looking for this energetic voice style for your next TV ad, or perhaps even for a more specialist explainer video? Please get in touch. I'd be very happy to send a short sample before you book me. Please send a few lines of the script first so you can be sure I'm right for the brand or project. I make the whole process as easy as possible with 99% of the jobs delivered the same day.
